svg.title: Slonczewski CPP/MTJ torque versus Zhang-Li CIP domain-wall torque in Fullmag
svg.desc: Two-panel publication diagram comparing (a) Slonczewski CPP/MTJ trilayer geometry and computed angular asymmetry epsilon_DL(theta) at P=0.40 for Lambda in {1.0, 1.5, 2.0}, and (b) Zhang-Li CIP domain-wall spin profile m(x) with conventional current J_c, electron drift, adiabatic drag, and non-adiabatic canting, plus the single Gilbert-to-explicit conversion invariant.
